description: MCP server (npm @ysskrishna/markdown-convert-mcp) that converts CommonMark/GFM Markdown to Slack mrkdwn, Microsoft Teams HTML, Jira Cloud ADF JSON and plain text through four tools, plus a companion agent skill.
rules: Run the server with npx -y @ysskrishna/markdown-convert-mcp (Node.js 22 or later); it speaks MCP over stdio.
Every tool takes one argument, markdown (string). Pick the tool by destination: markdown_to_slack, markdown_to_teams, markdown_to_jira, markdown_to_plaintext.
The tools only convert text; they never send Slack or Teams messages or create Jira issues.
Input over 200,000 characters returns a tool error (isError: true); whitespace-only input returns an empty string.
